dct_description_sm: [English] A summary of the data used in the article "Abrupt shifts in the concentration, composition, and reactivity of dissolved organic carbon along boreal land-water continua", by Chokhachi-Baradaran et al. This study aims to undertand the composition and reactivity of dissolved organic carbon during its journey from land to water across 16 watershed continue in two boreal regions of Quebec, Canada.

[Français] Résumé des données utilisées dans l'article "Abrupt shifts in the concentration, composition, and reactivity of dissolved organic carbon along boreal land-water continua", par Chokhachi-Baradaran et al. Cette étude vise à comprendre la composition et la réactivité du carbone organique dissous durant son passage de la terre vers l'eau à travers 16 bassins versants continus dans deux régions boréales du Québec, Canada.
dct_title_s: Data and metadata for the article "Abrupt shifts in the concentration, composition, and reactivity of dissolved organic carbon along boreal land-water continua" [Quebec, Canada]
